## Project context
We are building a Support Ticket Management System.
- Backend: Java 21, Spring Boot 3.x, Spring Web, Spring Data JPA, Bean Validation
- Database: PostgreSQL in normal runs, H2 only for tests (or file-based H2 for local dev)
- API: REST + JSON
- Frontend: React (Vite) or Next.js
- Build/test: Maven, JUnit 5, Spring Boot Test, MockMvc
- AI tools: Cursor, GitHub Copilot

Features: create, list, view and update tickets (title, description, priority, assignee), add comments,
search by keyword, filter by status, persist data, validate input on the backend, and show clear errors in the UI.
